notes: Butcombe's Allergy Aware page lists 55 pubs, each linking to its own viewthe.menu page (e.g. szyb = The Methuen Arms, szeb = The George Inn). format: JSON the page loads (AEM page model, allergen-matrix.model.json) holding one HTML table; also script-rendered on the HTML page
serving_basis: 'kcal per Unit/Portion' (per unit as sold, one number per product); no protein/carbs/fat
notes: 93 product rows in 8 ranges (Baked Confectionery 21, Hot Savoury 17, Chilled Prepacked 15, Hot Sandwich 12, Co-op Bakery 11, Co-op Baked Confectionery 9, Bakery 6, Sauce 2); 91 have kcal (HP Brown Sauce and Heinz Ketchup blank). Columns: product range, Shell code, product name, kcal, then 14 allergen columns (Celery, Cereals containing gluten with the cereals named in brackets, Other cereals, Crustaceans, Egg, Fish, Lupin, Milk, Molluscs, Mustard, Nuts, Other nuts, Peanuts, Sesame, Soya, Sulphites) marked 'Y' = contains, so allergens are complete and on the same row as the kcal (names identical). Read with json.loads, find the string containing 'kcal per Unit', parse its <table>. Hundreds of Shell forecourts; the range varies by forecourt and some items are Co-op or third-party brands. shell.co.uk robots allows the page and the .model.json. The table is re-issued monthly, so the script must record the validity month. Good first pick.
